definitions.explanation: The state of a substance containing a particular component or ingredient. A technical term used in chemistry, nutrition, and product specifications.

examples.japanese: ⟦カルシウム→カルシウム：10963_karushiumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{含有|がんゆう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ミネラル→ミネラル：23090_mineraru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{含有量|がんゆうりょう}→含有量：22566_ganyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This water has a high mineral content.

examples.japanese: ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{含有|がんゆう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未成年|みせいねん}→未成年：13016_miseinen⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The sale of alcohol-containing beverages to minors is prohibited.

notes:
A technical term for something containing a specific substance or component. Composed of {含|がん} (contain/include) + {有|ゆう} (have/possess). Primarily used in scientific, medical, and regulatory contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{含有量|がんゆうりょう}→含有量：22566_ganyuuryou⟧: content (amount contained)
- {含有率|がんゆうりつ}: content ratio; percentage contained
- {含有|がんゆう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to contain (a substance)
- {含有|がんゆう}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: contained components/ingredients
- ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧{含有|がんゆう}: alcohol-containing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: to contain, to include — the everyday verb; used broadly in both literal and figurative senses
- ⟦{配合|はいごう}→配合：16196_haigou⟧: blending, compounding — mixing ingredients deliberately, often in cosmetics or food
- ⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: ingredient, component — what a substance is made of

USAGE:
{含有|がんゆう} is a written/technical word. In everyday speech, ⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧ or ⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧ would be used instead. {含有|がんゆう} commonly appears on product labels, nutritional information, and scientific papers.
